description_text:
|| Cutted Wood Stacks ||
Cutted Wood Stacks AAA PBR Game Ready Asset, is a high quality, low poly asset originally modeled in 3DS Max 2018.
The normal map was baked from a high poly model in Substance Painter 2020, making this product look very detailed without using many polygons. This product is intended for game/real time/ usage. This model is not intended for subdivision.The polycount is similar to the modern FPS AAA games.
The renders and wireframes were done in Marmoset Toolbag 3. (The triangulation of the the mesh topology is caused by Marmoset).
||SPECS||
Low Poly Model:
Includes: .obj, .max, .fbx, .3ds files.
.obj,.fbx and .3ds versions exported from 3ds Max 2018 . 
The individual planks used to create the stacks are included.
An Unreal Engine 4 project is also included with textures. Ready to be used in your game.
An Unity package is also available. 
Substance Painter workfile is included.
|| Geometry ||
Stack 1:
2.054 Total Polys
1.896 Total Verts
3.476 Total Tris
Stack 2:
2.600 Total Polys
2.400 Total Verts
4.400 Total Tris
Stack 3:
660 Total Polys
360 Total Verts
660 Total Tris
Model unwrapped manually to make most efficient use of the UV space.
Model scaled to approximate real world size. All materials and objects named appropriately.
Tested in Marmoset Toolbag 3 (see renders).
No special plug-ins needed to use this product.
|| Textures ||
Textures for Unity 5 and Unreal Engine 4 can be downloaded.
Textures in .targa format:
2k texture set. -PBR Textures (Basecolor, ambient occlusion, metallic, roughness, normal) -Unreal Textures (Basecolor,Normal, Occlusion/Roughness/Metallic) -Unity Textures (Albedo/Transparency, Metallic/Smoothness, Normal)

description_text: The sculpture of the Yellow River Mother is composed of a mother and a baby boy. They respectively symbolize the mother of the Yellow River, who nurtures the Chinese nation and never gives up, and the happy and thriving descendants of China. The sculpture has a simple composition and profound meaning, reflecting the ancient history and culture of Gansu.The material selection for the sculpture of the Yellow River Mother is ordinary granite, which can better express the color of the Yellow River and the skin color of the descendants of the Yellow River. At the same time, the rough texture of granite seems to tell the story of the vicissitudes and great changes experienced by the Chinese nation for thousands of years. The composition is concise and profound, symbolizing the mother of the Yellow River who nurtures the Chinese nation's endless vitality and indomitable spirit, as well as the happy and thriving descendants of China. The pedestal of the Yellow River Mother Statue is engraved with water ripples and fish patterns, originating from the primitive patterns of ancient painted pottery in Gansu Province, reflecting the long history and culture of Gansu. description_text:
Model created for educational/background purposes. The clouds and night-lights can be easily adjusted to your preference. A noise texture was used for the stars. Can be disabled in the node editor.
Model has 5 objects, each with a material with the same name as the object. The material contains the textures, if textures are missing just assign the right image textures. The scene also has a camera and light.
I didn't use a UV Map, I used texture coordination to assign all the textures. I used a bump map for the clouds and terrain.
Textures provided(jpg and png):
Earth: 8192 x 4096Bump: 21600 x 10800Clouds: 4096 x 2048Lights: 16384 x 8192Ocean Mask: 10800 x 5400
Formats provided:
.blend file
The model was created in Blender 2.78b, everything is already set up. To make things easier, move the texture files into the same folder the .blend file is, if by some chance the textures don't display, you just need to assign the textures to the correct nodes (tutorial included). 
The scene colour was set to black, you can move the sun lamp around to light the earth or simply change the scene colour.
All objects have the correct names with correct material names.
All objects scaled to 1,1,1 and rotation to 0,0,0Scene units is set to meters.The dimensions of the model is 20m x 20m. With a radius of 10m and diameter of 20m.

description_text:
A realistic looking ocean scene made in 3dsmax and Vray only. A nice ocean shader with some subsurface planes and Environmental Fog plus Depth of field set to go. 
Keep in mind that this scene only works if you have Vray plugin installed. The entire scene is made with VrayDisplacementMap. This is no complex scene with heavy surfaces or modeling plugins. Just couple of Planes displaced via material editor. To animate this scene all you need is to adjust Phase and Offset settings in materials. If you find complex scenes bothering and familiar with 3ds max, then you are good to go. 
(Sunrise and Daylight HDR's included)
Have fun!

description_text:
Hi-res 3d model of grass patches for green meadows.
The bundle contains 13 different grasspatches:  3x flat, 3x short, 3x long, 1x dead grass, 3x clumps
There are 9 bigger patches with a diameter of 50cm (20inches) but also 3 smaller clumps and a dead grass patch. 
Can be used for close up shots or as scatter objects on landscapes.When populated on landscapes the models are best used as instance or proxy because of the polycount (~20k quads per patch)

  - each model comes with 2K PBR textures (png), suitable for close up shots and animation

  - clean topology, mostly quads

  - carefully modelled to real world scale(centimeters)

  - materials and textures have unique and meaningful names

  - each model has proper unwrapped UVs (0-1 space).

Maya file has VRay Standard Materials (VRayMtl) assigned.Preview images rendered with VRay.
Two kinds of texture maps included:

  - Textures ready for V-Ray(diffuse, specular, glosiness), also suitable for most render enginges;

  - PBR metalness workflow (basecolor, metallic, roughness), ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and other real-time apps.

description_text:
High-quality, highly optimized 3D model of a modern wooden sauna house / log cabin. This exterior architectural asset is perfectly tailored for professional outdoor environment rendering, suburban real estate presentations, cottage community layouts, and landscape design visualizations.
With a highly efficient mesh of only ~10k polygons and an incredibly lightweight file size (~3 MB), this model serves as an ideal background asset or standalone feature project. It delivers beautiful photorealistic wood aesthetics without slowing down your workstation's viewport or bloating heavy scene files.
Key Features & Specifications:

  - Optimized Mid-Poly Geometry: Only 10,312 polygons, making it perfect for rapid rendering and populating large-scale outdoor environments.

  - Photorealistic Shading: Fully textured with rustic wood and glass materials applied and configured.

  - Precision Setup: Completely built to accurate real-world scale using Millimeters (mm) system units.

  - Origin Centered: The asset is perfectly positioned at the center of the coordinates system (0,0,0).

  - Clean Architecture: Texture paths are fully stripped; meshes are manually unwrapped for a flawless finish.

  - Standard Workflow: No third-party plugins or external script tools are required to open or render.

Technical Details:

  - Polygons: 10,312

  - Vertices: 11,652

  - Native File Format: 3ds Max 2014 (with custom Corona Renderer materials configured).

  - Wide Compatibility Exchange Formats: OBJ (1.24 MB), FBX (659 KB), 3DS (766 KB).

  - Textures: All high-resolution image maps and materials are fully included in the package archive.

Cross-Platform Compatibility Note: The model is natively prepared for 3ds Max and fine-tuned for Corona Render. Thanks to the clean geometry and standard file exports, importing the universal exchange formats (.FBX, .OBJ, or .3DS) into Blender (Cycles/Eevee), Cinema 4D, SketchUp, ArchiCAD, or Lumion is highly seamless. Shaders may require simple re-assignment depending on your software of choice.
Enhance your Nordic or rustic country landscape scenes with this cozy backyard oasis. If you are satisfied with the asset quality, please leave a positive feedback — community-approved model! Check out my complete profile gallery for more high-quality furniture sets and architectural assets.

Outdoor Bench-1-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
This is a medium detailed model of a bench for outdoor space,ready to drop into any scene or be used as a stand-alone prop.This model will make Visualization “alive” due to realism and attention to all details.Originally modeled at 3ds Max 2009 sp1. Final images rendered with VRay 1.5sp2There is no post-production at renders above.Material setup is included only in the V-Ray version, as per the preview images.Carefully detailed and cleanly structured objects.Fully detailed - texture maps.Just merge in your scene, check texture paths and hit render.Real world scale and exact proportions.Multiple file formats including 3ds Max scanline version.Studio setup is not included in any scene files.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------FEATURES-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* 'SMOOTH MODIFIER' and 'UVW MAPPING' options are not collapse in the scene file.* Professional quality model designed for ease of use - No cleaning up necessary,   just drop your model into the scene and start rendering.* UV's & textures fully applied. Concrete Barrier Collection low-poly 3d model ready for Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR), games and other real-time apps.

Easy to convert model in other formats. fbx file includedNo need for any special plug-in to open the model. Useful for games, high resolution renders, magazines and production.
Clear topology. No multi/Sub-Objects materials. Export formats works correctly.
Model include game-ready texture.
